questions.question: If 23 January 2002 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 26 January 2007?
questions.solution:
Given: **23 January 2002** was Wednesday.

Now,

2002 to 2007 = 5 Years (4 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 5 Years = 1 Leap Year and 4 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 4 Ordinary Years have 4 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 4 = 6

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(3, 12, 26)

(7, 9, 53)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 2nd number) - 10 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (3, 12, 26)

⇒ (3 × 12) - 10

= 36 - 10 = 26.

For, (7, 9, 53)

⇒ (7 × 9) - 10

= 63 - 10 = 53.

Similarly, for **(7, 5, 25)**

**⇒ (7 × 5) - 10 **

**= 35 - 10 = 25.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements :**

All space is wind.

Some wind is earth.

Some fire is earth.

**Conclusion (I) :** All earth is space.

**Conclusion (II) :** Some wind is fire.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a3353087cb9eecfa93b3d0c9f5e02a43915b7997ae4c8ae84ebbaabdf5522ec.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All earth is space → Does not follow (As all space is wind and some wind is earth. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some wind is fire → Does not follow (As some wind is earth and some fire is earth. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**"

questions.question:
If ‘E’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘U’ stands for ‘×’, ‘A’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘C’ stands for ‘-’, what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

16 A 24 C 30 E 15 U 9 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 16 A 24 C 30 E 15 U 9 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 E
 U
 A
 C
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 16 + 24 - __**30 ÷ 15**__ × 9 = ?

⇒ 16 + 24 - __**2 × 9**__ = ?

⇒ __**16 + 24**__ - 18 = ?

⇒ __**40 - 18**__ = **22**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".

questions.question:
If 'A' stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

16 B 8 D 51 A 3 C 57 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 16 B 8 D 51 A 3 C 57 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 16 × 8 - __**51 ÷ 3**__ + 57 = ?

⇒ __**16 × 8**__ - 17 + 57 = ?

⇒ __**128**__ - 17 __**+ 57**__ = ?

⇒ __**185 - 17**__ = 168.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
